title: Nonparametric Empirical Bayes Confidence Intervals
summary: Empirical Bayes methods can improve inference on unobservable individual effects by borrowing strength across units. This paper proposes nonparametric empirical Bayes confidence intervals (NP-EBCIs) for unobservable individual effects in a normal means model. The oracle intervals are constructed from posterior quantiles under a point-identified, fully nonparametric prior; feasible intervals replace these quantiles with nonparametric estimates.
